representative_size_domain.basis: Chen et al. (2023), p.3328 uses the 51-149-customer stopping regime; p.3331 Table 8 uses one 71-customer private instance. The repository evidence inventory maps the representative comparison and ablation to one 51-149-customer China81 instance.

quantile_definition.method: Hyndman-Fan type 7 / linear interpolation, identical to numpy.quantile default
quantile_definition.identity_blinding: Threshold distributions were computed over all 81 values and written here before any qualifying instance id was listed.
quantile_definition.missing_value_policy: No imputation. Any missing required dimension makes that instance ineligible. If no instance qualifies, stop without relaxing thresholds.

algorithm_component.definition: Among seeds 1-5, count cases where M final_cost - MV final_cost > 1e-9 in the sealed old-vehicle batch.
algorithm_component.selection_boundary: The old 140.41 kWh vehicle and old fleet limits make this a discrimination prior only; absolute costs and improvements are not new-model results.

fleet_electrification.definition: Across the five certified 0/25/50/75/100% levels, take max over all level pairs of abs(physical_cv_used_i-physical_cv_used_j)+abs(physical_ev_used_i-physical_ev_used_j).

carbon_timing.definition: Count unique (seed, action_index) charging actions for which at least one of the 28 registered days has candidate_count>1 and CARBON predicted charging emissions at least 1e-9 kg below ASAP.

dynamic_demand.definition: Apply the frozen H0/G2 20% independent-disclosure generator to stream seeds 1-5. Per instance, require the common event count per stream and the type-7 10th percentile of due_time-t_appear over all five streams.

due_slack_p10_seconds.distribution_basis: all-81 q1 of the per-instance p10 values

selection_order: Keep only instances in the 51-149 customer representative-size domain.
Keep only instances meeting every frozen dimension threshold; no compensating weighted score is allowed.
Choose the remaining instance with the largest customer_count.
If tied, choose the lexicographically smallest full instance_id. This tie-break uses no outcome magnitude.
forbidden_after_freeze: Changing a threshold, metric, population, seed set, tolerance, size domain, or tie-break after candidate identities are evaluated.
Ranking by the largest cost improvement, emissions reduction, or number of formal wins.
Using any new path search, formal experiment, or later reported experiment outcome to alter this selection.
no_relaxation_rule: If the intersection is empty or a required dimension is unavailable, record HALT_NO_ELIGIBLE_REPRESENTATIVE_INSTANCE or HALT_DIMENSION_NOT_EVALUABLE; do not weaken the rule.
